No communication or responses to our queries for over a month.|[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Cornelius Wagglehorn]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CS" />}}
'''Corellia University research outpost''' was a research outpost on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], that was part of [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], members of the [[Cult of Exar Kun]] traveled to the outpost, to recruit some of the researchers and students to their ranks. One researcher refused, as he claimed that they were being forced to join against their will, so the cultists killed him.

After the University lost contact with the outpost, [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Cornelius Wagglehorn]] hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to go and find out what had happened. The spacer found the outpost deserted, but learned the truth of what had happened from the dead researcher's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellia University research outpost was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Corellia University research outpost was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
